content.title: External Blocker Replan | Resource Check to an Accepted Alternative
content.summary: Establish one intended action, keep an external blocker visibly active, and show the character checking the specific resource that could overcome it. Confirm the resource is unavailable, choose a setting-compatible alternative activity, and end with stable proof of acceptance while the blocker remains unresolved.

quick_start.input_format: intended action and enabling condition + persistent visible external blocker + physical check for one enabling resource + confirmed resource absence + setting-compatible alternative activity + stable acceptance while the blocker remains
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult marine ecologist carries a sealed sensor case toward a lake launch door when lightning closes the water. She checks the grounded remote-launch battery shelter, finds its status light dead, then turns to sample annotation under a warm task lamp and ends absorbed in the new work while lightning remains visible outside.
required_anchors: Establish one intended action and its enabling environmental condition before the blocker appears.
Keep one external blocker visibly active while the character evaluates it.
Confirm resource absence before beginning a setting-compatible alternative activity.
End on stable emotional or behavioral evidence of acceptance while the blocker remains unresolved.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one intended action, keep an external blocker visibly active, and show the character checking the specific resource that could overcome it. Confirm the resource is unavailable, choose a setting-compatible alternative activity, and end with stable proof of acceptance while the blocker remains unresolved.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one ordinary intended action and the environmental condition required to complete it. Introduce one visible external blocker, then show the character checking the specific enabling resource that could overcome it. Confirm that the resource is unavailable through legible physical evidence. Let the character choose a setting-compatible alternative activity, preserve the blocker in the background, and end on a stable affective proof that the revised plan is genuinely accepted. The reusable mechanism is intended action, external blocker, resource check, confirmed deficit, chosen alternative and settled payoff—not the source woman, bookstore, rain, umbrella, coffee, book, clothing, window layout, exact performance, creator identity or model claim.

invariants.rule: Establish one intended action and its enabling environmental condition before the blocker appears.
invariants.purpose: Gives the interruption a measurable goal cost.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a prior intention, the obstacle is only atmosphere.

invariants.rule: Keep one external blocker visibly active while the character evaluates it.
invariants.purpose: Maintains causal pressure across the decision.
invariants.ablation_failure: Removing the blocker before the choice makes the pivot unmotivated.

invariants.rule: Show a physical check for one specific resource that could overcome the blocker.
invariants.purpose: Turns decision logic into observable action.
invariants.ablation_failure: A purely facial reaction hides the causal test.

invariants.rule: Confirm resource absence before beginning a setting-compatible alternative activity.
invariants.purpose: Separates failed solution from deliberate replanning.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting the alternative too early makes it look preplanned.

invariants.rule: End on stable emotional or behavioral evidence of acceptance while the blocker remains unresolved.
invariants.purpose: Proves adaptation rather than temporary distraction.
invariants.ablation_failure: Reopening the original goal prevents closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's face, hair, grey hoodie, bag and exact performance
the source bookstore, cafe counter, shelves, rainy street, window geometry and warm-cool lighting arrangement
the source umbrella check, coffee, book, table actions and exact event order or timing
the source framing, depth of field, weather texture, expression sequence and character identity
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.0 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
